column1: # catalog/prequeue-fast-lints.tsv — the fast lint set the merge conductor runs
# on a READY head merged onto current main, before it enqueues it (BH-8473).
# bin/prequeue-fast-lints.sh reads it; bin/lib/mc-prequeue.d/fast-lints.sh is
# the conductor's hook. The settings row lane.merge-conductor.mc_prequeue_fast_lints_set
# picks rows by id (a comma list; empty = every row). A command is never a
# settings row: it lives here, in git.
# One row per item, four TAB-separated columns, none empty:
#   id      stable name; the settings row, results.tsv and the log line use it
#   argv    what runs, from the root of the tree under test (bash -c). `@trace`
#           is the runner's trace item: bin/test-trace-safety.sh --gate on the
#           tests/*.sh and tests/mc/*.sh the diff origin/main..HEAD adds or edits
#   suite   the name a park reason gives (prequeue-red: <suites> on main …)
#   reason  one plain line: what it catches, and the red batch that asked for it
# tests/lanes-registry.bh-2205-test.sh is not a row: it runs the suite below
# twice on copies of the tree (231 s) and catches nothing that suite does not.
# Rows run in this order, longest first (measured on a build box, 2026-10-26),
# so the slowest item starts at once and the set fits its budget.
